newsitem.title: UK: ICI hit by Merrill downgrade.
newsitem.headline: ICI hit by Merrill downgrade.

text.p: Shares in Imperial Chemical Industries remained weak on Monday as analysts at Merrill Lynch downgraded earnings forecasts on concerns over the persistent strength of sterling, dealers said.
The shares fell 40p to 808-1/2p by 13.56 GMT in volume of over four million shares.

Market sources said Merrill analysts, who declined to comment, had cut their current year profit forecasts to 450 million stg from 530 million previously and 1998 forecasts were downgraded to 640 million stg from 740 million stg.
Merrill analysts blamed the rise in sterling, which hit a 59-month high against the German mark on Monday, for the estimate cuts, market sources said.
